title: Consistent Modified Gravity Weak Lensing in Energy-Flow Cosmology: The µ–Σ Eigenmode, Destructive Interference, and E_G as the Orthogonal Probe
abstract: Derives the observable eigenstructure of EFC in weak lensing (Case B). Shows that weak lensing constrains only one effective parameter η_eff = γ(µ-1) + (Σ-1) = 0.017. Growth suppression from µ < 1 cancels 66% of lensing amplification from Σ > 1 (destructive interference). Proves E_G measures Σ/µ^γ (orthogonal to WL), predicting E_G^EFC/E_G^GR = 1.086 (+8.6%). Five sealed predictions registered prior to Case B run.
